name: article-backend
description: API REST backend for article sharing
author: hcano <hcano@escoladeltreball.org>

scripts.certs: mkdir -p certs && openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -sha256 -days 365 -keyout certs/key.pem -out certs/cert.pem -subj /CN=localhost -addext subjectAltName=DNS:localhost,IP:127.0.0.1
